name: Depravity
overview: Scripture reveals the profound depravity of mankind, showing that from birth humans are inclined toward sin and wickedness, as seen in Genesis 6:5 where every thought of the heart is continually evil. This total depravity is further emphasized in Psalms 51:5 and Psalms 58:3, which illustrate that sinfulness is innate and begins even in the womb. Isaiah 64:6 underscores that all human righteousness is like filthy rags before God, and Jeremiah 13:23 highlights the difficulty of changing this sinful nature, likening it to a leopard changing its spots. Together, these passages affirm that human depravity is comprehensive and deeply rooted, necessitating divine intervention for true transformation.
